lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Grid of circular high-intensity pixel clusters on the lateral flank, forming roughly horizontal rows and vertical columns posterior to the pectoral fin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of higher luminance intersect with the horizontal rows of circular spots, most prominent in the mid-flank region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Parallel linear features running horizontally along the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp transition from high luminance on the dorsal side to low luminance on the ventral side.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular trailing edge of the pectoral fin with visible indentations.
other_distinctive_markers: Two distinct, elongated high-luminance shapes attached to the posterior edge of the pectoral fin.
